description: Machine-readable belt-use estimates (FARS within-vehicle designs) for downstream modules.  All estimates are conditional on a crash severe enough to kill an occupant of the vehicle (fatal crash); rows with _misreport_fXX are sensitivity analyses, not alternative primary estimates.  DPC rows: n_vehicles = driver / right-front pairs with at least one death; conditional-logit rows: matched sets (vehicles) with discordant outcomes; matched-pair rows: two-occupant vehicles with one death
population: FARS 2016-2024 occupants (driver/passenger) of in-transport light passenger vehicles, seat front-left/front-other/second row, age 13+, belted or unbelted, known outcome
method: See method column; primary = fatality_risk_reduction_belt_given_fatal_crash (Evans DPC, percentile crash-cluster bootstrap CI)
